plan.title: Promote TypeScript task check as the release pre-flight and drop the Python bridge (Phase 1)

narratives.Description: The maintainer release pre-flight still runs scripts/ci_local.py through the packages/core/src/release/python-bridge.ts shim. This story promotes the TypeScript task check to the primary release Step-5 pre-flight and removes the Python bridge so the release flow carries no Python pre-flight dependency.
narratives.ImplementationPlan:
- Rewire the release Step-5 pre-flight to call the native TypeScript task check path directly instead of ci_local.py via the python-bridge shim.
- Delete packages/core/src/release/python-bridge.ts and its references, then add or update a release test asserting Step-5 uses the TypeScript pre-flight.
narratives.UserStory: As a maintainer cutting a release, I want the Step-5 pre-flight in TypeScript, so that the release flow no longer depends on the ci_local.py Python bridge.

items.title: Given the release flow, when Step-5 pre-flight runs, then it invokes the native TypeScript task check path and not ci_local.py.

narrative.Acceptance: Given the release flow, when Step-5 pre-flight runs, then it invokes the native TypeScript task check path and not ci_local.py.

items.title: Given packages/core/src/release, when the bridge is removed, then python-bridge.ts no longer exists and nothing imports it.

narrative.Acceptance: Given packages/core/src/release, when the bridge is removed, then python-bridge.ts no longer exists and nothing imports it.

items.title: Given the release test suite, when it runs, then it asserts Step-5 uses the TypeScript pre-flight.

narrative.Acceptance: Given the release test suite, when it runs, then it asserts Step-5 uses the TypeScript pre-flight.

expected_outputs: release Step-5 uses TS task check
